title: As Onondaga County studies data centers, Ryan McMahon urges state to repeal tax exemption
summary: Onondaga County Executive Ryan McMahon, representing county executives statewide, is urging Governor Hochul to repeal a 26-year-old state tax exemption law that allows data centers to avoid sales tax. This action signals county concern about revenue loss and the competitive landscape around data center development in the region.
